notes: Confirmed against FSR's own manufacturer spec sheet (LIT1346A), which matches the product page description exactly. No RJ-45 category/speed rating is stated for the base T3-AC2 keystone pass-through jacks, so grade was omitted (a separate T3-AC2-CAT6 SKU exists with CAT6-rated jacks — not this model). This is a furniture/table-mount box (3.5" round cutout), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. The device also has empty snap-in keystone bays that can optionally be populated with network, telephone, RCA, or mini-stereo connectors by the installer — those are user-configurable options, not fixed physical I/O, so they are not listed as ports. Hardwired variants (T3-AC2HW) replace the captive line cord with direct-wire leads/wire nuts; this listing reflects the standard plug-in T3-AC2.

ports.name: AC Line Cord (In)
ports.note: 9' integral 14 GA SJT captive power cord terminating in Edison plug; feeds the two outlets below. Hardwired -HW variants omit this cord entirely (direct-wire leads + wire nuts instead).

ports.name: AC Outlet 1
ports.note: 12A max per outlet, 12A total draw across both outlets

ports.name: AC Outlet 2
ports.note: 12A max per outlet, 12A total draw across both outlets
